updates.title: [TOUCH] Qualify edge accuracy, endurance and resume after N71 multitouch bring-up
updates.body:
## Current state — reviewed 2026-11-16
Automatic Z2 initialization and genuine Linux single-contact/simultaneous two-finger EVDEV input have passed on N71 / Samsung S8000. The original missing-touch and calibration ACK blockers are resolved for the tested RAM payload. Older comments below describe historical experiments.

## Physically achieved
- [x] Identify SPI2/Z2 transport, board requirements and private firmware/calibration handling.
- [x] Integrate board-specific kernel/DT changes and obtain controller calibration acknowledgement.
- [x] Register the real touchscreen and demonstrate tracking, movement and release.
- [x] Demonstrate simultaneous two-finger input after automatic startup.
- [x] Render the framebuffer cyberdeck proof of concept.

## Remaining acceptance
- [ ] Measure edge/corner accuracy and coordinate orientation across a defined grid.
- [ ] Measure latency and run a documented drag/multitouch endurance test with no stuck contacts.
- [ ] Recheck touch after a fresh integrated connectivity RAM boot.
- [ ] Qualify idle/blank/unblank and suspend/resume separately.
- [ ] Use real touch input in the terminal/on-screen-keyboard workflow; a framebuffer demo is not a complete UI.

Evidence: [automatic multitouch](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/docs/N71_Z2_AUTOINIT_PHYSICAL_MULTITOUCH_PASS_2026_11_11.md), [hardware matrix](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/docs/HARDWARE_STATUS.md), [cyberdeck architecture](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/docs/CYBERDECK_VISION_AND_ARCHITECTURE.md).

This issue stays open for the remaining qualification, not because multitouch is missing. S8003 remains untested. Keep calibration, firmware and identifying captures private.

updates.title: [WIFI] Qualify reconnect, 5 GHz and endurance after native N71 Wi-Fi success
updates.body:
## Current state — reviewed 2026-11-16
Native phone Wi-Fi works in the current managed RAM Linux session. The real BCM4350C5 PCIe endpoint (14e4:43a3) binds to brcmfmac with translated SID0 DMA and Linux MSI message 8 / AIC 264. The original no-PCI/no-WLAN blockers are resolved for the tested N71/S8000 path. Historical comments are not the current baseline.

## Physically achieved
- [x] Identify controller/module/PCIe port 1 and keep firmware/NVRAM private.
- [x] Enumerate the endpoint and qualify translated DMA/interrupt delivery.
- [x] Native scan and WPA2 authentication.
- [x] DHCP, native default route, DNS and Internet traffic.
- [x] SHA-256-verified 1 MiB transfer through the phone WLAN.
- [x] Managed start/unbind/unload with seven PCIe power domains restored.
- [x] Short coexistence trial: Wi-Fi Internet traffic during encrypted Bluetooth transfer.

## Remaining acceptance
- [ ] Recover association/DHCP after deliberate AP loss and service restart.
- [ ] Qualify 5 GHz association; the demonstrated link is 2412 MHz.
- [ ] Run a measured concurrent Wi-Fi/Bluetooth endurance trial.
- [ ] Recheck automatic network restoration after a new integrated RAM boot.
- [ ] Qualify suspend/resume and associated power states.
- [ ] Inventory/test monitor or AP modes separately if needed; normal connectivity does not establish monitor mode or frame injection.

Evidence: [physical result](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/docs/N71_NATIVE_WIFI_PHYSICAL_PASS_2026_11_16.json), [assessment](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/docs/PROJECT_STATE_2026_11_16.md), implementation commit 001966d.

This remains a qualification issue. Do not repeat resolved enumeration work or claim persistent boot support. No storage/baseband experiments or private firmware/credential uploads.

updates.title: [BT] Qualify reconnect, HID and power states after Dell pairing and encrypted data PASS
updates.body:
## Current state — reviewed 2026-11-16
BCM4350C5 UART HCI with genuine private patchram build 0825 is operational. RAM-local BlueZ/D-Bus completed LE discovery, classic Dell discovery, pairing, bonding and encrypted L2CAP data transfer. The old missing-patch/pairing blockers are resolved in the tested session.

## Physically achieved
- [x] Privately sourced board-compatible firmware loaded; enabled HCI with zero transport errors.
- [x] LE discovery: 12 devices seen; no nearby identifiers published.
- [x] Controlled classic discovery and Dell Paired/Bonded state.
- [x] Exact 256 × 256-byte encrypted echo (65,536 bytes), repeated in two controlled trials in the same RAM session.
- [x] Server requires the intended peer and security level 2; Wi-Fi remains connected with Internet traffic during the trial.
- [x] Temporary Dell discoverability restored after testing.

## Remaining acceptance
- [x] Reconnect after bluetoothd/private-bus restart without removing bonds: private bond state reloaded and encrypted Dell echo passed.
- [ ] Restore private bond state and repeat transfer after a new integrated RAM boot.
- [ ] Test actual HID keyboard or mouse input when hardware becomes available. No such peripheral is currently at hand; Dell is the present test peer.
- [ ] Test A2DP audio and BLE GATT applications separately if selected for the product.
- [ ] Qualify idle/suspend/resume and longer radio coexistence.
- [ ] Investigate the rejected optional privacy-setting request; address privacy is not qualified.

Evidence: [physical result](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/docs/N71_BLUETOOTH_PHYSICAL_PASS_2026_11_16.json), [runtime/security scope](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/docs/N71_BLUETOOTH_RUNTIME_2026_11_16.md), commit 570cb87.

Level 2 proves the required encrypted channel, not MITM-authenticated pairing. Same-session bonding is not reboot persistence; L2CAP echo is not HID/audio proof. Keep addresses, machine identity and bond keys private.
## Current-session recovery follow-up
Identity-guarded restart of BlueZ/private D-Bus, WPA and DHCP passed. A third controlled encrypted 65,536-byte Dell echo passed after recovery with zero HCI errors. This is service recovery, not a new boot. [Evidence](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/docs/N71_SESSION_FINALIZATION_UI_POWER_2026_11_16.md).

new_issues.title: [BOOT] Integrate and qualify automatic N71 touch, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth RAM startup
new_issues.body:
## Goal
Turn the verified manual/current-session runtime into a reproducible owner-private RAM boot. Current-session startup/idempotence and service recovery pass; the integrated new-boot candidate is built but not physically booted.

## Acceptance
- [x] Assemble a private candidate with pinned managed WLAN module/userspace, BlueZ/D-Bus and private provisioning; retain the known-good recovery image unchanged.
- [x] Verify tested runtime hashes, ARM64/UI architecture, archive boundaries and exact base-image component preservation; new init order still needs physical boot qualification.
- [x] Test startup idempotence and controlled service recovery in the current session: consecutive calls retained four daemon PIDs; all four recovered after deliberate stop.
- [ ] Preserve USB recovery on every startup failure and bound all waits.
- [ ] Perform a supervised new RAM boot and verify automatic touch, charging telemetry, WPA/DHCP/DNS and Bluetooth controller/bond restoration.
- [ ] Repeat native WLAN transfer and encrypted Dell L2CAP echo after boot.
- [ ] Record sanitized evidence; distinguish private bond provisioning from future persistent storage.

Scope: N71/S8000, RAM only. No NAND installation or untested generic-kernel replacement. [Startup candidate](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/scripts/n71_connectivity_autostart.sh), [architecture](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/docs/CYBERDECK_VISION_AND_ARCHITECTURE.md).
## Candidate prepared
A separate owner-private 25,066,924-byte RAM payload includes the connectivity runtime, private provisioning/bonds and native shell UI. m1n1/bootargs, both DTBs and kernel are unchanged; original CPIO entries are unchanged except init. The handoff command verifies the payload and refuses sending while current Linux is online. Physical DFU/Pongo transfer and reboot postflight remain untested. [Evidence](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/docs/N71_SESSION_FINALIZATION_UI_POWER_2026_11_16.md).

new_issues.title: [KALI] Build and qualify curated ARM64 security-tool userspace on N71
new_issues.body:
## Goal
Provide selected Kali tools on the phone while retaining the custom hardware-qualified N71 kernel and recovery/connectivity services. Kali is not installed or phone-qualified yet.

## Proposed first scope
Base shell/runtime plus Nmap, tcpdump, DNS/TLS utilities and bounded throughput diagnostics. Optional TShark/web-lab/Bluetooth/wireless packages follow measured demand. No blanket metapackage install, competing network daemons or claim of official iPhone NetHunter support.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Review/import a public reproducible build workflow; older offline-kit scripts are not currently present in this repository.
- [ ] Verify official signing key and repository metadata; resolve ARM64 versions, dependency closure, hashes and installed size.
- [ ] Measure free RAM, extraction peak and recovery headroom before staging a private candidate.
- [ ] Perform host ABI checks labeled HOST-ONLY, then execute versions/shell on the real phone.
- [ ] Run a controlled TCP-connect assessment against a deliberate Dell listener and a closed-port comparison.
- [ ] Capture/decode a bounded generated lab flow; retain PCAP privately.
- [ ] Stop the environment cleanly and verify touch/USB/WLAN/Bluetooth/charging remain available.
- [ ] Integrate touch launch/stop and later repeat the essential test after boot.

Native monitor mode, injection, AP mode and USB host adapters require independent hardware tests; installing tools does not enable them. [Detailed plan](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/docs/KALI_ARM64_INTEGRATION.md), [proposed profiles](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/manifests/kali-tool-profiles.json).

new_issues.title: [UI] Build touch-first cyberdeck launcher, terminal, keyboard and tool jobs
new_issues.body:
## Goal
A usable handheld Linux cyberdeck, not only a framebuffer proof of concept. Preserve the original fullscreen cyberpunk direction while making local console and selected security tools operable without an external keyboard.

## Baseline
Native dashboard 0.2 with a local PTY shell/on-screen keyboard is running on the phone; framebuffer readback and a native synthetic-key/real-command selftest passed. Manual human typing and Kali job integration are not yet qualified.

## Acceptance
- [x] Home shows real battery/temperature/current, CPU/RAM, native WLAN link and controller presence; labels do not imply untested profiles. USB recovery remains independently available.
- [ ] Open a local terminal, type/edit/execute commands and read scrollback using touch alone.
- [ ] Launch a selected tool against an explicit controlled target/interface; show progress and a stop/timeout action.
- [ ] Review bounded private output, export selected sanitized results and avoid logging credentials.
- [ ] Recover to a minimal shell when a tool or launcher fails.
- [ ] Verify rotation, touch hit regions, readability and thermal/resource behavior on 750 × 1334.
- [ ] Keep optional pinned projects/notes/briefing companion integrations separate from the first local-console gate.

A Bluetooth keyboard/mouse test is deferred until a real peripheral is available; it must not block touch-only input. [Product architecture](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/docs/CYBERDECK_VISION_AND_ARCHITECTURE.md).
## Native implementation follow-up
The static AArch64 app provides Home/Terminal/System/Tools, a real /bin/sh PTY, letter/symbol keys, Ctrl-C/Tab/backspace, reversible brightness choices and framebuffer/KD-mode cleanup. Native echo roundtrip and hardware probe passed. The console is ASCII/TERM=dumb, 48x24 visible characters: full VT emulation and scrollback remain open. Manual finger typing/optical acceptance is still required. [Source](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/tree/main/examples/cyberdeck-shell) · [evidence](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/docs/N71_SESSION_FINALIZATION_UI_POWER_2026_11_16.md).

new_issues.title: [SSH] Qualify key-only USB recovery access and retire unauthenticated Telnet
new_issues.body:
## Goal
Replace the current bench-only unauthenticated root Telnet path with verified authenticated recovery access. This has not yet been completed; authenticated_remote_shell remains blocked.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Build/provision an audited ARM64 SSH server and unique private host identity without committing secrets.
- [ ] Bind to the USB gadget address; inspect actual listeners and keep Wi-Fi ingress outside the initial recovery interface.
- [ ] Verify intended public-key login and trusted host fingerprint.
- [ ] Verify password and unauthorized-key refusal.
- [ ] Keep recovery available during cutover; only then stop Telnet and demonstrate TCP/23 closure.
- [ ] Reconnect and repeat after an integrated RAM boot.
- [ ] Publish only sanitized positive/negative results; keep keys, provisioning and raw sessions private.

[Detailed migration protocol](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/docs/REMOTE_SHELL_HARDENING.md). No live cutover is implied by this issue.

new_issues.title: [POWER] Qualify charging lease, idle behavior and cyberdeck endurance
new_issues.body:
## Baseline
Battery telemetry and positive net charging have been observed using a guarded 300 mA USB input lease. The lease lasts 3600 seconds; it has required renewal during active bench work. This is not autonomous long-term charging qualification.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Record charge/discharge and temperature under idle, display-on and concurrent WLAN/Bluetooth workloads.
- [ ] Define and test a bounded, temperature-aware renewal/shutdown policy before unattended use.
- [ ] Measure tool-runtime and extraction peaks, not just idle free RAM.
- [ ] Qualify full-charge behavior and safe return to original limits.
- [ ] Qualify blank/unblank and suspend/resume without losing recovery or corrupting radio state.
- [ ] Define an endurance window with resource/thermal evidence and clear failure conditions.

No permanent current-limit increase or unsupported power-management claim. [Current assessment](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/docs/PROJECT_STATE_2026_11_16.md), [hardware state](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/docs/HARDWARE_STATUS.md).
## Balanced current-session observation
Brightness reduced reversibly from 1505/2047 to 1023/2047; original value retained. Existing schedutil (300–1800 MHz) and WLAN power saving preserved; no overclock, unsupported HCI autosuspend or permanent charger change. A 15-second observation measured UI RSS 8,832 KiB and 0.31% aggregate CPU; temperature 33.7 C. Current varied, including -13 mA in one sample, so no autonomy or sustained-charge gain is claimed. A verified 4 MiB WLAN transfer passed with the UI active. [Evidence](https://github.com/arloo/iphone6s-linux-cyberdeck/blob/main/docs/N71_SESSION_FINALIZATION_UI_POWER_2026_11_16.md).
